acceptance.output_evidence: RECORD, no verdict. EVERY LEG EXERCISED, from the committed COVERAGE_EVIDENCE.json of the graded walk (381 involved nodes): token ONLY 210, iam_grant ONLY 92, trigger_target ONLY 33, source_text ONLY 7, and 39 on two or three legs (iam_grant+token 16, iam_grant+source_text 15, all three 8). Drop any leg and the contract loses rows: 58 of the 67 involved Lambdas carry NO token, and 92 nodes rest on iam_grant alone. THE NAMED EXCLUSION IS REAL AND FALSIFIABLE: the 9 LOG_GROUPs under /aws/lambda/ are live floor nodes (e.g. /aws/lambda/bd-49f-runner, drift DECLARED), each carried in coverage.by_node_type.LOG_GROUP.excluded with its own reason naming its function; the stated ground is that a log group is the runtime's per-function sink, holds no subject data and is re-created when its function -- which IS a row -- migrates, and the note says plainly what would falsify it (a pipeline that READS a log group, e.g. a metric filter feeding a gate). THE THIRD CLAUSE, ANSWERED WITH ITS OWN EVIDENCE AND ITS OWN LIMIT: at this vintage no LIVE Lambda is reached by trigger_target ALONE -- every Lambda an involved trigger targets is already reached by iam_grant or source_text -- so the live run cannot demonstrate that case and this instance does not pretend it does. The DRIVEN CONTROL does: e5_legs_control.py injects a graph in which one Lambda carries no token and is reached only by a token-named rule's target and another only by its role's grant; both come back involved on exactly that leg, an unlinked Lambda does not, the log sink is excluded, and removing the trigger edge drops the trigger-only Lambda (ALL-ARMS-HOLD). On live data the same forward step reaches non-token nodes through the grant leg: opal-assets-bd49f-daily-pull, -dim-convert and -reporting-pull have no word-bounded 49f token and are rowed through their roles' ALLOW on blackdiamond/49f prefixes. THE DEFINITION'S COST, DECLARED: opal-data-bd is a shared legacy monolith, so the grant leg admits 25 portal/news Lambdas that run as lambda-execution-role (13) or opal-portal-lambda-role (12) whose grants cover opal-data-bd/*. That is stated in the method note as a weighing for a reviewer, not hidden. TWO CUTS MEASURED AND RECORDED RATHER THAN QUIETLY MADE: source_text on raw text admitted cottonwood's bd-cot-keepalive on a COMMENT ('an EXPLICIT Deny on opal-data-bd -- ZERO 49F') and cot-rebalancer-runner on a guard message ('(never blackdiamond/49f)'), so the leg was narrowed to whitespace-free CODE string literals, 54 functions -> 31, with the residual over-reach named (irpt-intake-poller via a packaged test fixture literal); and trigger_target's reverse step admitted moltbot-ssm-sendcommand-alert through a shared alert topic, so reverse now applies onto COMPUTE only. THE VENDOR ALIAS IS REFUSED ON A STATED GROUND: 'bd' abbreviates the blackdiamond VENDOR that cottonwood and inflection share, and round 1's shortcode test rowed bd-cot-keepalive-sched and cot-bd-session-daily-et, both cottonwood's.
